notes.title: Download Replay now available!
notes.content:
[u]Gameplay Changes[/u]
- Leader board fixed.
- You can now download replays from other players.

[u]Level Changes[/u]
- None

[u]UI Changes[/u]
- Notification at the end of a level if you beat your current time or not.
- Notification when you download a replay from the main menu.

[u]On my list[/u]
- Race the dev mode.
- Download notification when downloading from end level screen.

notes.title: Leaderboard forced upload
notes.content:
- Manual replay save removed
- Added auto replay save and upload on setting a new time

notes.title: Level update
notes.content:
- Slight level updates for 1 + 2
- Menu buttons fix on level 2 + 3

notes.title: Leader board and performance update
notes.content:
- Added leader board
- Removed tree from level 1
- Added performance options (very low, low, medium, high, very high, ultra)
- Various fixes.

notes.title: Various bug fixes + level 3 now included
notes.content:
- Added temporary art work for introduction cinematic.
- Updated loading screen text.
- Jump indicator is now on by default.
- Adjusted cutscene skip at the start of the level.
- Added a new jump to level 1 to make it more obvious where to go. 
- Fixed a bug where the canvas would not fade in all the way at the start of a level after you skip.
- Added race music.
- Added a "Help I'm Stuck" button in the options menu which should return you back to your nearest checkpoint.
- Disabled Greek hat collider.
- Slightly adjusted jump height on hard mode. 
- Fixed a bug with the scroll collectible on level 2.
- Added ghost feature v0.1.

notes.title: Fixes
notes.content:
[list]
[*]Visual bug - If you do a jump and hold right click from the top the rock has a jumpier movement down that if you don't. - FIXED
[*] Audio - the ambient sound seems to crackle every now and then on tutorial level. - FIXED
[*] Gameplay bug - On respawn if you touched a wall or the ground and didn't jump before respawn your jump resets allowing for skips due to spawning at height. - Fixed
[/list]

notes.title: QoL Update
notes.content: Lots of quality of life changes

notes.title: Quick fix
notes.content: Fixed level select and quicksave and quickload

notes.title: Demo build update
notes.content: New demo build including first level and taster of last level.
